text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One night, as summer camp was entering its 
final stage—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
――It's rare for you to invite me to a jam 
session.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Need some Music? I've got plenty of 
tracks that go great with the ocean."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I will— aim for—the Autumn Senior Triple 
Crown."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...The 'Japan Cup.' There, Tap... I 
will—defeat you."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha!! ――Is that right, is that how it 
is?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
To think that you... chose to change 
everyone else instead of yourself...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
OK, Kris S. As the most fired-up I've ever 
been, I'm gonna overcome this "ordeal" 
named you at the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Summer camp comes to an end. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The autumn of the decisive battle was 
already right before our eyes—
